title: strkey.Decode accepts strkeys whose payload breaks the per-type length and padding rules
severity_basis: Acceptance of invalid input (SEP-23 invalid vectors return a payload). Fixed in v0.7.2.

entries.observed: Executed: v0.7.1 strkey.Decode returns a 5-byte payload instead of an error; v0.7.2 rejects it. Earlier versions were not run.
Executed: v0.7.1 strkey.Decode returns a 33-byte payload instead of an error; v0.7.2 rejects it. Earlier versions were not run.
Executed: v0.7.1 strkey.Decode returns a 41-byte payload instead of an error; v0.7.2 rejects it. Earlier versions were not run.
Executed: v0.7.1 strkey.Decode returns the payload with its inconsistent length prefix instead of an error; v0.7.2 rejects it. Earlier versions were not run.
Executed: v0.7.1 strkey.Decode returns the payload with its inconsistent length prefix instead of an error; v0.7.2 rejects it. Earlier versions were not run.
Executed: v0.7.1 strkey.Decode returns the unpadded payload instead of an error; v0.7.2 rejects it. Earlier versions were not run.
Executed: v0.7.1 strkey.Decode returns a signed payload declaring 0 inner bytes instead of an error; v0.7.2 rejects it. Earlier versions were not run.
Executed: v0.7.1 strkey.Decode returns the payload with its 0xff padding instead of an error; v0.7.2 rejects it. Earlier versions were not run.
Executed: v0.7.1 strkey.Decode returns a 32-byte payload under the M version byte instead of an error; v0.7.2 rejects it. Earlier versions were not run.

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --set all), L4, on go@v0.7.1.
evidence.post_fix: go@v0.7.2 and later reject the same vectors.
evidence.expected_basis: SEP-23 v1.4.0 lists these strkeys as invalid (stellar-protocol at f2d36490).

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 9 of 9 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0024.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added.
